title: Petra and the Visitor
author: Juniper Sterling
blurb: Quentin Eastwick, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
